scope: Theorem 7.1 of the manuscript “A group without fixed price” (preprints/A-group-without-fixed-price-October-5-2026/unequal-costs-rank-100-amalgam.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 259 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 aa2ee4de0db26fc8), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 21-22. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let V and T be sets of cardinality n. For each t ∈ T , let rt = xc(t,0)xc(t,1) · · · xc(t,99), c(t, i) ∈ V, D = ⟨xv (v ∈ V ) | rt = 1 (t ∈ T )⟩. 21 For T ⊆ T , put N(T) = {c(t, i) : t ∈ T, 0 ≤ i ≤ 99}. Call a row t bad if it has a repeated column, or if it shares at least two distinct columns with another row, and let b be the number of bad rows. Suppose that 0 < α < 1 200 , αn ≥ 1, 100b ≤ αn, and that |N(T)| > 96|T| whenever 1 ≤ |T| ≤ αn. (24) Then the minimum size of a generating set of D satisfies rk(D) > αn 100 .
